guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 确定你属于哪个群体
guide.description: 找出这三组中哪一组首先适合你。 Substack 和 Channel 5 收件人通过官方 portal 通过电子邮件领取。 TRUMP 损失接收者永远不会使用它，因为这些代币通过交易所移动。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Identify Which Cohort You Fall Under
guide.original_description: Work out which of the three groups applies to you first. Substack and Channel 5 recipients claim by email through the official portal. TRUMP loss recipients never use it, since those tokens move through exchanges.

guide.title: 验证合约地址和域名
guide.description: 该项目将其官方 Base 合约列为 0xB095274743941e953c746F9C228DA9c18Bb6ec29。在官方 LAPTOP 网站上验证它，而不是通过筛选器或搜索结果。我们的加密货币安全指南解释了虚假领取页面的工作原理。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Verify the Contract Address and Domain
guide.original_description: The project lists its official Base contract as 0xB095274743941e953c746F9C228DA9c18Bb6ec29 . Verify it on the official LAPTOP website rather than a screener or a search result. Our crypto safety guide explains how fake claim pages work.

guide.title: 打开官方领取 portal
guide.description: 转到 LAPTOP 领取 portal 并输入与你的 Substack 或 Channel 5 订阅相关的电子邮件。它会在你提交之前显示你的资格和分配情况。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the LAPTOP claim portal and enter the email tied to your Substack or Channel 5 subscription. It shows your eligibility and allocation before you commit.

guide.title: 连接邮箱并创建嵌入式钱包
guide.description: 连接一个合格的邮箱地址，如果你有分配，请连接钱包。使用嵌入式钱包，导出密钥或随后将代币移出，因为访问取决于该服务的持续运行。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Connect an Email and Create an Embedded Wallet
guide.original_description: Connect an eligble Email adress, connect wallet if you have an allocation. With an embedded wallet, export your keys or move the tokens out afterwards, since access depends on that service staying up.

guide.title: 在 Base 上用 ETH 为钱包充值
guide.description: 自托管领取需要在 Base 上使用少量 ETH 作为 Gas。在 Bybit 上购买 ETH 并直接提现到 Base，或者使用下面的组件从另一个网络转移一些。跨链基金无需离开此页面即可在 30 多个链之间进行交换和跨链。路线快，费用低。立即跨链打开交互式桥组件在新标签页中打开跨链页面
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Fund the Wallet With ETH on Base
guide.original_description: A self-custody claim needs a little ETH on Base for gas. Buy ETH on Bybit and withdraw straight to Base, or move some across from another network using the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 30 天之内提出领取
guide.description: 签署领取交易并确认代币到达。阅读你签署的内容。合法的领取永远不会要求你提供助记词，也不会要求你先发送资金。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Sign the claim transaction and confirm the tokens arrive. Read what you sign. A legitimate claim never asks for a seed phrase and never asks you to send funds first.

guide.title: 检查你的交易所是否有 TRUMP 损失份额
guide.description: 如果你通过 TRUMP 损失获得资格，请观看你进行交易的交易所或应用的公告。每个场地都有自己的规则，因此分配情况各不相同，有些可能会被排除在外。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Check Your Exchange for the TRUMP Loss Share
guide.original_description: If you qualify through TRUMP losses, watch announcements from the exchange or app where you traded. Each venue sets its own rules, so allocations vary and some may sit out.

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。
